findings.description: The `return` after `req.reject(requeue=False)` was removed. When the ETA conversion fails, the request is rejected but execution continues: eta stays None, so the code reaches `task_reserved(req)` and `handle(req)` (or `limit_task` when a rate-limit bucket exists). A task that was just rejected and dropped is therefore also executed immediately, and it may be acked or rejected a second time.
findings.title: Missing return after rejecting task with invalid ETA

findings.description: The `mark_as_failure` call was removed, so a task with an unconvertible ETA is rejected without any failure state being stored. Clients waiting on the result never see a failure and may hang or see PENDING indefinitely.
findings.title: Failure no longer recorded in result backend
